title: I Hear the Words of Love
lyrics_original: I hear the words of love,
And I have peace with God.
The clouds may go and come,
And storms may sweep my sky—
My love is oft times low,
My joy still ebbs and flows;
But peace with Him remains the same,
His love, not mine, the resting place,
His truth, not mine, the tie.

bible_verses.english: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
and through him to reconcile all things to himself, by him, whether things on the earth or things in the heavens, having made peace through the blood of his cross.
Therefore, receiving a Kingdom that can’t be shaken, let’s have grace, through which we serve God acceptably, with reverence and awe,

devotional.prayer_english: Lord God, thank You for the whispers of Your grace and the enduring power of the cross. When life feels chaotic and the clouds gather, remind my heart that my peace rests securely in You. Thank You for making peace through the precious blood of Jesus and welcoming me into Your unshakeable kingdom. Fix my eyes on Your eternal love today. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: When the storms of life create uncertainty around us, the cross stands as an unshakeable anchor of God’s love. Through the mighty sacrifice of Jesus, our peace with the Father is not dependent on our shifting emotions or circumstances, but on His steadfast character. Looking to His shed blood, we hear the ultimate message of grace—that we are fully loved and forever reconciled. Today, take a deep breath and rest in the calm, everlasting peace that Christ has secured for your soul.
